name: ai-slide-templates
description: Turn real content into browser-openable HTML presentations with 87 Cogine AI slide templates.

interface.shortDescription: Create HTML presentations from 87 distinct templates.
interface.longDescription: Shape notes into a slide outline, compare visual directions, and build a finished HTML presentation. Downloads a versioned template library on first use and checks the finished deck in a browser. Requires Node.js 22+, Git and browser access.
defaultPrompt: 把这些材料整理成演示大纲，推荐合适的模板并生成 HTML 幻灯片。
Show me a few suitable visual directions for this presentation.
Use my chosen template to build and verify an HTML deck.
